text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The authorities ban politicians from gathering on the site of a car bomb explosion in Belcourt suburb in Algiers where more than 40 people died last week.
- The authorities require authorisation to allow politicians and citizens to mourn bomb victims in Algiers.

- Rally for Democracy and Culture, Ettahadi, Democratic Forces Front, Algerian Movement for Development and Justice and several feminist groups were banned from laying a wreath on bombing site in Belcourt to mourn vicitms.
- Several politicians and other citizens laid a wreath in Belcourt to mourn victims of a car bomb attack.
